title: Rollout anchoring and contrast handoff for cost lenses
creator: Maya Delacroix
description: Create a cohesive pattern and Figma library subset to anchor rollout state to cost lenses while improving color contrast and accessibility. Deliverables: a) prototype of rollout anchor interactions in cost dashboards, b) updated token set with semantic contrast scales for primary/secondary/caution states, c) component variants (badge, state-rail, sparklines) with clear handoff tokens and usage guidance for engineers and PMs.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive prototype demonstrates anchor behavior for canary / primary / fallback model rollouts in cost explorer with keyboard/voice focus outlines
Token palette includes semantic contrast levels (normal, elevated, critical) mapped to WCAG 2.1 AA with examples at 12px and 14px text sizes
Figma components updated and published to the Console Design System library with documented variants and code references
Design handoff notes and token JSON exported and attached to the ticket; ENG has actionable token names and example CSS/TAILWIND mappings
Accessibility review sign-off from a11y reviewer and PM acceptance that rollout states are unambiguous in low-vision scenarios
tasks: Audit existing cost-lens components for contrast and state ambiguity
Prototype anchored rollout rail and inline badge states in Figma
Validate color pairs against WCAG at targeted text sizes
Create token migration plan and map legacy tokens to new semantic names
Prepare engineering handoff artifacts and record short walkthrough video
comments: 2025-02-12 Maya Delacroix: Kickoff — outlined scope and dependencies. Noted that ENG will need a short meeting to align on token naming conventions. Asked PM to prioritize rollout acceptance criteria.

2025-02-14 Liam Chen: Uploaded initial prototype frames to Figma and left notes on interactive anchors. Need product confirmation on whether 'canary' badge should be yellow or orange based on risk semantics.
2025-02-16 Priya Kapoor (a11y): Quick scan shows current caution contrast fails at 12px. Recommend adding a bold variant or stronger semantic token for caution-critical pair.
2025-02-17 Noah Rivera (PM): Confirming that canary = orange (higher visibility) per rollout playbook. PM approves using orange-600 for inline badges; devs to verify with token matrix.
2025-02-19 Liam Chen: Pushed token JSON draft to the design-tokens repo and linked PR. Waiting on ENG review for naming collisions with legacy tokens.
2025-02-20 Maya Delacroix: Updated prototype per a11y feedback and attached recorded walkthrough. Marking ticket In Review and asking for ENG/PM sign-off before closing.
review_notes: a11y: require focus-visible outlines that are at least 2px and use contrast-aware color
ENG: prefers semantic names like --semantic-rollout-primary / --semantic-rollout-warning instead of component-scoped names
PM: rollout states must be reversible visually when a model fallback occurs (use motion to show fallback, not color alone)
Design: prefer token-driven offsets for elevation rather than ad-hoc shadows to keep density consistent
decisions: Adopt semantic token naming convention for rollout states (semantic-rollout-{primary,warning,critical,muted})
Use orange-600 for canary badges and orange-400 for less prominent in-rail indicators after contrast tuning
Publish a 'cost-lens' subset of components in the design system with explicit variant rules for size and density
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Token rename collisions with legacy implementations — Mitigation: provide migration map and dual-publish period
Risk: Visual noise in dense dashboards when anchors and badges co-occur — Mitigation: add spacing rules and limit simultaneous states to 2 per row
Risk: Accessibility failure for small text — Mitigation: prefer semi-bold weights for labels and provide alternate color pairings
next_steps: Schedule 30-min sync with ENG (owners: Liam, Priya) to approve token JSON and mapping
Finalize Figma library slice and bump library version to v2.13
Create migration RFC for legacy tokens and share with Platform team
Ship short walkthrough video to ENG and PM and request sign-off by 2025-02-24
estimated_workflow: Design -> a11y review -> ENG token review -> PM acceptance -> Library publish
notes_for_engineering: Token JSON PR contains both legacy alias keys and new semantic keys for a 2-release deprecation window
Provide CSS examples: .rollout-badge { background: var(--semantic-rollout-warning); color: var(--text-on-warning); border-radius: 8px }
When in doubt prefer higher contrast token for mobile small text sizes
